product.stepsText:
What happens after you buy

You buy the kit. No photo needed today.
We email you a personalisation link in your order confirmation, one for each kit. Forward it to the person you're gifting, whenever you choose, or open it yourself.
They choose their photo and design their mosaic in our Creator. The kit is already paid, so there's nothing more to pay.
They approve the design. We email them a design proof to check before we make anything.
We make the kit and ship it directly to them.

Buying more than one? Each link can go to a different person, or one person can combine two or more links into one bigger mosaic.
